title: 6 inch dust ruffle
text: 6 inch dust ruffle. I have an adjustable base that sits closer to the floor.  I do NOT like a dust ruffle that drags on the floor, so this little 6" ruffle is PERFECT for my tastes.  It does arrive from outside the USA - just fyi... washed up well and I may order a second one as a back up because it is so hard to find a short dust ruffle.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope this review was helpful to you.
